_comment: Retrieval eval fixture (v2). All content is invented and generic — no real names, clients, or secrets. The corpus deliberately contains near-miss distractor clusters (several port facts, several TLS/outage events, competing queue discussions) so ranking quality actually shows up in the numbers. See docs/eval-harness.md.

memories.content: The staging database for acme-corp runs on port 5544.
The production database for acme-corp runs on port 5432.
Deploy cadence is weekly, every Thursday at 14:00 UTC.
The acme-corp public API base URL is https://api.example.test/v2.
The CDN cache TTL for static assets is 86400 seconds (one day).
On 2026-05-03 the payments service had a 22-minute outage caused by an expired TLS certificate. Mitigation was certificate renewal plus an auto-renew cron.
Migrated the metadata store from Postgres 14 to Postgres 16 over the weekend; pgvector extension reinstalled and indexes rebuilt.
Shipped the onboarding-widget feature behind a flag for beta accounts; rollout to all accounts planned for next sprint.
Decided to use RabbitMQ over Kafka for the job queue because the team already operates RabbitMQ and throughput needs are modest.

memories.subject: billing-service
memories.content: billing-service is healthy; p95 latency 180ms, error rate under 0.1%.
The shared Redis cache for acme-corp listens on port 6390 (non-default to avoid collisions).
The RabbitMQ management console is exposed on port 15672, internal network only.
The production database for globex-media runs on port 5433.
Prometheus metrics retention is 30 days; long-term metrics are downsampled into the analytics warehouse.
Database backups run nightly at 03:15 UTC with a 14-day retention window; restores are tested monthly.
On-call rotation switches every Monday at 09:00 local; the schedule lives in the ops calendar.
The widget-pro subscription SKU is WGT-PRO-9941 and is billed annually.
On 2026-06-11 search latency spiked to 4s p95 for about an hour after an index rebuild saturated disk IO; resolved by throttling the rebuild job.
On 2026-04-19 the staging environment briefly served an invalid TLS chain during a certificate rotation dry-run; no customer impact, runbook updated.
Switched the CDN provider for static assets to reduce egress cost by roughly 40%; cache warm-up completed within two hours.
Raised the public API rate limit from 60 to 120 requests per minute per key after sustained 429 complaints from integration partners.
Launched the globex-media newsroom portal; first 48 hours saw 12k unique visitors with no errors.
Decided to consolidate the three service repositories into a single monorepo to simplify dependency upgrades and CI caching; migration scheduled over two sprints.
Decided to keep the home-grown feature-flag system instead of adopting a vendor; the flag surface is small and vendor pricing scales per seat.
Decided to use Kafka for the analytics event stream (distinct from the job queue) because replayable history matters there; RabbitMQ stays for background jobs.
Decided to retire the legacy PDF report generator after usage dropped below 2% of accounts; sunset notice goes out next month.

memories.subject: search-service
memories.content: search-service is healthy after the June index-rebuild incident; p95 latency back to 220ms.

memories.subject: onboarding-widget-rollout
memories.content: onboarding-widget rollout is at 50% of accounts; error budget intact, full rollout gated on next week's review.

memories.subject: monorepo-migration
memories.content: monorepo migration is in progress: two of three repositories merged, CI pipeline green, remaining repo scheduled this sprint.
Error budget policy: a service that burns more than half its monthly budget freezes feature deploys until burn rate normalizes.
Q2 load test passed: sustained 3x normal traffic for 30 minutes with p99 under 800ms across all core services.
Support SLA for priority-1 tickets is a 30-minute first response, 24/7, handled by the on-call engineer.
Completed the quarterly dependency audit; upgraded twelve packages, removed two unused transitive dependencies, zero known vulnerabilities remain.
The widget-basic subscription SKU is WGT-BAS-1204 and is billed monthly.
